name: add_change_point
description: Applies an additive post-anchor regime change with an optional immediate level jump and ongoing slope change.
semantic_triggers: after this point the level shifts

constraints.anchor_timestep: Must be a valid timestep in the series.
constraints.level_change: At least one of level_change or slope_change must be non-zero.
constraints.slope_change: At least one of level_change or slope_change must be non-zero.
constraints.end_timestep: If provided, must be greater than or equal to anchor_timestep and within series bounds.

examples.text: After timestep 40, the signal jumps up by 2 and then climbs faster.

name: add_decay
description: Overwrites an interval with an exponential decay-shaped curve between start and end values.

constraints.start_timestep: Must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: Must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.

examples.text: From timestep 20 to 60, decay smoothly from 10 down to 2.
examples.call: add_decay(series, start_timestep=20, end_timestep=60, start_value=10.0, end_value=2.0, decay_rate=2.0)

name: add_dip
description: Adds a sharp negative local event at a timestep, optionally spread across a narrow triangular window.

constraints.timestep: Must be a valid timestep in the series.
constraints.amplitude: Provide either amplitude or target_value, not both.
constraints.target_value: Provide either amplitude or target_value, not both.
constraints.width: Must be zero or greater; provide either width or half_width, not both.
constraints.half_width: Canonical alias for the integer half-window radius; provide either half_width or width, not both.

examples.text: At timestep 75, add a narrow downward spike of magnitude 4.

name: add_flat
description: Overwrites an interval with a constant value, creating an exactly flat segment.

constraints.start_timestep: Must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: Must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.

examples.text: Keep the signal flat at 3 between timesteps 10 and 25.

name: add_gap
description: Overwrites an interval with missing values or a fixed fill value to represent a gap.

constraints.start_timestep: Must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: Must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.

name: add_growth
description: Overwrites an interval with an exponential growth-shaped curve between start and end values.

constraints.start_timestep: Must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: Must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.

examples.text: From timestep 15 to 50, grow from 1 to 8 with accelerating curvature.
examples.call: add_growth(series, start_timestep=15, end_timestep=50, start_value=1.0, end_value=8.0, growth_rate=2.5)

name: add_level_shift
description: Adds a sustained level shift from a start timestep through the rest of a tail interval, optionally with a smooth onset.

constraints.start_timestep: Provide either start_timestep or anchor_timestep, not both; the chosen timestep must be within the series bounds.
constraints.anchor_timestep: Provide either anchor_timestep or start_timestep, not both; the chosen timestep must be within the series bounds.
constraints.shift: Provide either shift or target_value, not both.
constraints.target_value: Provide either shift or target_value, not both.
constraints.end_timestep: If provided, must be greater than or equal to the chosen start timestep and within series bounds.

examples.text: Starting at timestep 60, shift the series upward by 1.5.

name: add_noise
description: Adds Gaussian noise over an interval using a deterministic random seed or generator.

constraints.start_timestep: If provided, must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: If provided, must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.
constraints.random_seed: Provide either random_seed or random_generator, not both.
constraints.random_generator: Provide either random_seed or random_generator, not both.

examples.text: Add mild Gaussian noise between timesteps 0 and 99 using seed 7.

name: add_outlier
description: Edits a single timestep to an exact value or by an additive one-point offset, creating an outlier.

constraints.timestep: Must be a valid timestep in the series.
constraints.target_value: Provide exactly one of target_value, relative_change, or delta.
constraints.relative_change: Legacy additive delta name; provide exactly one of target_value, relative_change, or delta.
constraints.delta: Canonical additive offset name; provide exactly one of target_value, relative_change, or delta.

examples.text: Make timestep 12 an anomalous point at value 20.

name: add_peak
description: Adds a positive Gaussian-shaped local bump centered on a timestep within an optional edit window.

constraints.timestep: Must be a valid timestep in the series.
constraints.amplitude: Provide either amplitude or target_value, not both.
constraints.target_value: Provide either amplitude or target_value, not both.
constraints.width: Must be positive; provide either width or spread, not both.
constraints.start_timestep: If provided, the interval must include timestep.
constraints.end_timestep: If provided, the interval must include timestep and be greater than or equal to start_timestep.
constraints.spread: Canonical alias for Gaussian spread; provide either spread or width, not both.

examples.text: Create a rounded peak centered at timestep 40 with width 3.

name: add_ramp
description: Overwrites an interval with a linear ramp defined by exact series values or slope.

constraints.start_timestep: Must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: Must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.
constraints.start_value: Use this primitive when the caption specifies absolute series levels over the interval, such as moving from one value to another.
constraints.end_value: Provide either end_value or slope, not both. Prefer add_ramp when the caption gives an absolute endpoint level for the series.
constraints.slope: Provide either end_value or slope, not both.

examples.text: From timestep 5 to 20, draw a straight ramp from 1 to 6.

name: add_seasonality
description: Adds a periodic waveform over an interval with configurable amplitude, period, phase, baseline, and waveform shape.

constraints.start_timestep: If provided, must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: If provided, must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.
constraints.waveform: Must be one of sine, cosine, square, sawtooth, or triangle.

examples.text: Add a sine wave with amplitude 2 and period 12 across the full series.

name: add_spike
description: Adds a sharp positive event at a timestep, optionally spread across a narrow triangular window.

constraints.timestep: Must be a valid timestep in the series.
constraints.amplitude: Provide either amplitude or target_value, not both.
constraints.target_value: Provide either amplitude or target_value, not both.
constraints.width: Must be zero or greater; provide either width or half_width, not both.
constraints.half_width: Canonical alias for the integer half-window radius; provide either half_width or width, not both.

examples.text: Insert a sharp spike at timestep 18 with amplitude 6.

name: add_trend
description: Adds an additive linear drift over an interval using either a slope or explicit additive endpoint offsets.

constraints.start_timestep: If provided, must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: If provided, must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.
constraints.slope: Provide either slope or both start_value and end_value, or both start_offset and end_offset. Use slope for additive drift relative to an existing baseline, not for setting absolute series levels.
constraints.start_value: Legacy endpoint-delta spelling. When slope is omitted, either start_value/end_value or start_offset/end_offset must both be provided; do not mix naming schemes. These values represent additive deltas, not absolute series values.
constraints.end_value: Legacy endpoint-delta spelling. When slope is omitted, either start_value/end_value or start_offset/end_offset must both be provided; do not mix naming schemes. These values represent additive deltas, not absolute series values.
constraints.start_offset: Canonical additive endpoint offset. Provide together with end_offset and do not mix with start_value/end_value.
constraints.end_offset: Canonical additive endpoint offset. Provide together with start_offset and do not mix with start_value/end_value.

examples.text: Add a steady upward drift of 0.1 per timestep from timestep 0 to 49.

name: add_trough
description: Adds a negative Gaussian-shaped local depression centered on a timestep within an optional edit window.

constraints.timestep: Must be a valid timestep in the series.
constraints.amplitude: Provide either amplitude or target_value, not both.
constraints.target_value: Provide either amplitude or target_value, not both.
constraints.width: Must be positive; provide either width or spread, not both.
constraints.start_timestep: If provided, the interval must include timestep.
constraints.end_timestep: If provided, the interval must include timestep and be greater than or equal to start_timestep.
constraints.spread: Canonical alias for Gaussian spread; provide either spread or width, not both.

examples.text: Create a rounded trough centered at timestep 55 with width 2.

name: add_volatility
description: Rescales existing deviations within an interval around a baseline, increasing or reducing volatility without changing the local mean reference.

constraints.start_timestep: Must be within the series bounds.
constraints.end_timestep: Must be greater than or equal to start_timestep and within series bounds.

examples.text: Double the fluctuations between timesteps 20 and 40 around the segment mean.
